retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1990s-style portrait featuring a subject in white against a saturated orange field with a multi-layered graphic header.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a white outfit reclines in a sculptural red chair against a solid, vibrant orange background. The top third of the composition features a complex graphic header with overlapping red and orange circles and wavy lines, hosting two distinct typographic styles.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in white provides a high-value focal point against the warm orange field
The red sculptural chair anchors the bottom left and creates a diagonal flow toward the subject's face
The graphic header at the top balances the weight of the chair at the bottom
Overlapping circles in the header echo the curves of the chair and the subject's pose
coreInvariants: Graphic header with abstract circular and wavy elements
Contrast between fluid script and rigid wide sans-serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the width with limbs extending toward the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red sculptural chair in the bottom left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the white-clad subject, move up to the script name, then across to the secondary title, and down the curve of the chair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat orange around the subject create a clean, pop-art feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with high value contrast between the white subject and the warm background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid brush script and extended geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a connected, fast-moving brush script with varying stroke thickness
Secondary text uses an ultra-wide, monolinear sans-serif with significant letter spacing
Italicization is applied to the sans-serif to imply motion
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'P' and 'L' feature exaggerated loops
The sans-serif 'A' has a low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, handwritten script and rigid, industrial geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The ultra-wide tracking of the secondary text
The white color of all typography

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, energetic movement of the primary name text
Matches the wide, geometric, 90s-tech feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a person in a white outfit reclining in a red sculptural chair against a solid orange background. Include a graphic header at the top with overlapping red and orange circles and a wavy red border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a white brush script at the top left. Add the secondary title in a white, ultra-wide, italicized sans-serif at the top right, spaced out significantly.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated orange?
Is the secondary text ultra-wide and italicized?
Does the header contain abstract circular shapes?
Is the subject wearing all white?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp graphic edges in the header

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text is legible against the graphic background
Ensure the wide sans-serif has enough tracking to feel 'airy'
Verify the red chair provides a strong visual anchor
Confirm the orange background is uniform and vibrant
recipe.reuseFormula: Vibrant Orange Field + White Subject + Red Sculptural Prop + (Script Name / Wide Sans Title) Header
